text:
mika: Quick poll: soundtrack for ‘work-from-couch, rain tapping on windows’ + one short paperback rec (<=200p). Funniest/strangest pair wins lunch? Keep it under 3 suggestions each. :cloud_rain:

sam: Khruangbin instrumental set -> pair with "The Mezzanine" (Baker). mellow grooves + tiny obsessions. :guitar:

leo: FM-84 / synthwave for afternoon boost -> pair with "The Stranger" (Camus). brisk and weirdly clarifying. :sunny:

tara: The Go! Team for chaotic indie + "Convenience Store Woman" (Sayaka Murata). silly energy, very readable. :tada:

mika: love the contrasts. anyone do a moody soundtrack + very short gothic?
sam: The Microphones - The Glow Pt. 2 (lo-fi, introspective) + "The Death of Ivan Ilyich" (Tolstoy). bleak in a compact way. :skull:

leo: also vote for a film pairing instead of book? French New Wave rainy-day double feature: "Le Rayon Vert" + "Jules et Jim" (short runtime combo).
tara: ooh, film option counts as a wildcard. we should do 2 playlists: upbeat & broody.
mika: jukebox-bot, assemble two 12-track playlists: "couch-rain-upbeat" and "couch-rain-broody" from these recs. include 1 instrumental track each. :robot_face:

jukebox-bot: Playlists created. couch-rain-upbeat: https://play.example/pl/xyz_up (12 tracks). couch-rain-broody: https://play.example/pl/xyz_bro (12 tracks). Expires in 7 days.

sam: casting votes: upbeat -> The Go! Team (tara), broody -> Khruangbin + Microphones (sam/leo).

mika: tie-breaker rule: whoever brings cookies to the kitchen meeting wins. who can bring tomorrow? :cookie:

leo: I can bake something small. chocolate chip?
tara: i'll bring tea bags and a tin of bergamot.
sam: i will bring instant coffee, you monsters. :coffee:

mika: perfect. final wrap: two playlists, book picks for personal reading, movie wildcard. lunch prize: cookies. meetup 2pm in the kitchen for listening + trade. :headphones:
